reading.body:
Digital Realty ORD11 is a 146,000 square foot data center in Chicago at 600 South Federal Street, part of a clustered multi-building campus near O'Hare airport that includes at least three other facilities on adjacent addresses in Franklin Park. The operator's published specifications do not confirm the critical IT load in megawatts for this individual building. Without a power figure, the capacity cannot be translated into racks or accelerators.

Illinois has 44 mapped data center facilities, of which only 6 publish power capacity. The state's total published capacity is 236 MW. ORD11's rank among published facilities in Illinois is 7th, meaning at least one facility not counted in the state total exceeds it. The operator has not published a power figure for this site, so its actual contribution to that ranking cannot be verified from tier-1 sources.

The absence of a published megawatt specification for an individual building in a major operator's metro campus is common; Digital Realty may publish capacity at the campus level rather than per-building. This reading cannot assess whether ORD11 materially affects AI scaling constraints in Illinois or the grid region until power capacity is available from the operator's own site.
